svg.title: Two progeny genotypes and phenotypes
svg.desc: Upper group: complete mutant homolog paired with complete wildtype homolog; all genes wildtype phenotype. Lower group: complete mutant homolog paired with a+ b+ f+ deletion homolog; wildtype a,b,f and mutant c,d,e. Deletion uncovers recessive c-,d-,e- alleles, which are hemizygous, not homozygous. Each rod is one unreplicated chromosome; blue unlabeled arms precede centromeres. Spacing and bands are schematic.
svg.text: Wildtype a, b, f; mutant c, d, e
Deletion uncovers recessive c, d, e alleles.
